Hymn 50: Come, Thou Glorious Day of Promise
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Gottfried W. Fink
Lyricist/Text Author: Eliza R. Snow
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 50 titled "Come, Thou Glorious Day of Promise" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Gottfried W. Fink and the lyrics were written by Eliza R. Snow.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
